description_html.value:
Academic focus

This BA combines archaeological evidence with anthropological approaches to human societies across time and place.

Curriculum and teaching

Students study archaeological methods, human evolution and social analysis through lectures, tutorials and practical classes. Fieldwork and a final dissertation form part of the course.

Research environment

Teaching draws on Oxford archaeology and anthropology specialists and on museum resources. Approved fieldwork may take place in field, laboratory or museum settings.
